user_saw: On installs with an unmigrated legacy memory index, `openclaw doctor --fix` warned that the recovery manifest was missing a root entry and continued without sealing a pre-repair recovery copy.
summary: Doctor now captures declared SQLite sidecar paths through their database image and applies the same rule when checking whether a sealed copy can be reused.
reasoning: The original capture code already omitted SQLite sidecar entries while retaining declared roots, and the manifest validator required an entry for every root. I checked the parent and diff of #169436, which added the Memory Core backup inventory and began declaring the legacy database and its SQLite companions as separate file resources, exposing the existing mismatch.
